name: save-last-response
description: Stop hook that saves every turn to ~/.claude/last_responses/<session id>_<nnn>.md (with <session id>.md symlinked to the newest turn of that session and last.md to the session that stopped most recently): the prompt as a level 3 heading, every AskUserQuestion with the answer it got, Claude's final response with Markdown headings pushed down two levels, and the turn duration line.
